name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Interactive floating Tic-Tac-Toe mini-game with local 2-Player mode and intelligent AI opponent.
longDescription:
Bring playful entertainment into your PDF workflow! Features single player vs AI (with Easy, Smart, and Unbeatable difficulties) and local 2-player pass-and-play mode. Deeply integrated with FryPDF shell overlay, status bar, and command palette.

### Key Features:
• **Floating Shell Overlay**: Smoothly drags and docks on top of any document workspace.
• **Single Player vs Smart AI**: Multiple difficulty settings with strategic minimax moves.
• **Local 2-Player Mode**: Play head-to-head with friends or colleagues.
• **Score Counter**: Live score tracking for wins, losses, and draws.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette, Status Bar, and Ribbon View Tab.
contributedFeatures: Shell Overlay: Floating Tic-Tac-Toe Game Card
Command Palette: 'Play Tic-Tac-Toe (Shell Overlay)'
Status Bar: Clickable '🎮 Tic-Tac-Toe' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Tic-Tac-Toe Action Button

name: Retro Arcade Snake Game
description: Playable, draggable retro-arcade Snake game floating over the application canvas in the 'shell.overlay' slot.
longDescription:
Bring playful retro-arcade entertainment into your document workflow! This extension mounts a high-performance floating Snake game into the 'shell.overlay' slot.

### Key Features:
• **Non-Modal Floating Overlay**: Runs smoothly on top of any document or workspace page without interrupting your PDF work.
• **60+ FPS Smooth Avalonia Drawing**: Direct DrawingContext GPU rendering with zero Large Object Heap allocations.
• **Tactile Custom Chrome Frame**: Dark retro arcade aesthetics with D-Pad and score counters.
• **Interactive Controls**: Keyboard arrows/WASD, on-screen tactile D-Pad buttons, difficulty & speed selection.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette, Status Bar, and Ribbon View Tab.

Command Palette: 'Play Snake Game (Shell Overlay)'
Status Bar: Clickable '🐍 Snake' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Snake Game Action Button

name: Review Scratchpad & Notes
description: Floating Markdown scratchpad with live word/char counters and timestamp logs for PDF review.
longDescription:
Jot down rapid review notes, citations, page corrections, and checklists without leaving your current PDF screen.

### Key Features:
• **Automatic M3 Expressive Card Chrome**: Automatic draggable header, pin toggle, and minimize pill.
• **Live Word & Character Counter**: Keep track of notes and summary length in real time.
• **Quick Action Pills**: One-click timestamp insertions and notes clearing.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+N`), Status Bar (`📝 Notes`), and Ribbon View Tab.

Command Palette: 'Toggle Review Scratchpad (Shell Overlay)'
Status Bar: Clickable '📝 Notes' Indicator Pill

name: Document Telemetry HUD
description: Live performance telemetry HUD showing managed heap allocation, GC cycles, and memory trimming.
longDescription:
Monitor runtime engine health, managed memory, GC generations, and system architecture in a compact floating HUD.

### Key Features:
• **Real-Time Memory Telemetry**: Track managed heap size and GC frequency.
• **One-Click Heap Trimming**: Trigger immediate memory compaction and trimming during heavy PDF sessions.
• **Compact Floating Utility**: Stays parked neatly on top of the document workspace without obstructing tools.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+T`), Status Bar (`⚡ HUD`), and Ribbon View Tab.

Command Palette: 'Toggle Telemetry HUD (Shell Overlay)'

name: Music Player
description: Floating playlist-based music player with transport controls, seek/volume, and real ID3 metadata.
longDescription:
Play your own music while you work, without leaving your PDF workspace.

### Key Features:
• **Automatic M3 Expressive Card Chrome**: Draggable header, pin toggle, and minimize pill.
• **Playlist**: Add local audio files (MP3, WAV, FLAC) and build a persistent playlist.
• **Real Metadata**: Title, artist, album, and embedded cover art read from each file's tags.
• **Full Transport Controls**: Play/pause, next/previous, stop, seek bar, volume, and repeat modes.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+P`), Status Bar (`🎵 Music`), and Ribbon View Tab.
highlights: Playlist with real ID3 metadata & cover art

name: Image Editor
description: A Canva-style layered design editor: fill/stroke/gradient styling, layers panel, grouping, free rotation, smart guides, inline text editing, an 8-template gallery, and project save/load.
longDescription:
Compose graphics directly inside your PDF workspace with a full-featured, resizable floating design editor.

### Key Features:
• **Layer-based Canvas**: Stack Text, Rectangle, Ellipse, Arrow, and imported Images in Z-order, with a clickable Layers panel (visibility/lock/rename), multi-select, marquee-select, grouping, and align/distribute.
• **Full Style Controls**: Fill & stroke color pickers, gradient fills (linear/radial), stroke width/dash style, corner radius, opacity, and precise numeric X/Y/Width/Height/Rotation fields.
• **Click-to-Place Tools & Eyedropper**: Click or drag directly on the canvas to place shapes and text, or sample any on-canvas color with the eyedropper — with V/T/R/E/A keyboard shortcuts.
• **Free-Angle Rotation & Group Resize**: Drag-to-rotate any single element or a whole multi-selection around a shared pivot (15° Shift-snap), plus proportional group resizing.
• **Smart Alignment Guides & Inline Text Editing**: Snapping guide lines while dragging, plus double-click-to-edit text directly on the canvas.
• **Undo/Redo**: Full edit history across every mutation — moves, resizes, rotations, crops, grouping, and color adjustments.
• **Zoom & Pan**: Smooth cursor-anchored zoom, pan, and fit-to-window on a resizable canvas.
• **Per-Image Crop, Rotate & Flip**: Precise crop handles with fixed-aspect presets (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16), 90° rotation, and horizontal/vertical flip, with aspect-ratio lock.
• **Deep Color Adjustments & 9 Filters**: Brightness/contrast/saturation/hue/temperature/tint/blur/sharpen sliders, one-click Auto-Enhance, and Black & White, Sepia, Vintage, Vivid, Noir, Invert, Duotone, and Vignette presets.
• **Duplicate, Copy & Paste**: Ctrl+D to duplicate and an in-app Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V element clipboard.
• **Template Gallery**: 8 starter templates — slide, certificate, flyer, photo collage, quote card, cover page, social post, and sticky note — each with a live-rendered preview.
• **Project Save/Load**: Save and reopen full editable projects as `.fryimg` files, with a confirm-before-discard safeguard.
• **PNG Export & Clipboard**: Export the full canvas to PNG, or copy it as a real image directly to the system clipboard.
• **Material 3 Expressive UI**: Fully theme-adaptive light/dark interface with segmented tool selectors and tactile sliders.
• **Shell Integration**: Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+I`), Status Bar pill, and Ribbon button.
